center: DAICO - Data & AI Center of Excellence, King Saud University (KSU)
sponsor: SDAIA (Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority)

courses.title: Foundations of Artificial Intelligence
courses.description: Introduces AI concepts, search, knowledge representation, and the ethics of AI systems. No prior programming required.

courses.title: Data Engineering Fundamentals
courses.description: Data pipelines, SQL, ETL, and warehousing. Prepares learners to build the data foundations that ML and AI systems depend on.

courses.title: Applied Machine Learning
courses.description: Supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and scikit-learn in practice.

courses.title: Deep Learning with PyTorch
courses.description: Neural networks, backpropagation, CNNs and RNNs, and training deep models with PyTorch on real datasets.

courses.title: Natural Language Processing
courses.description: Text representation, transformers, and fine-tuning language models for Arabic and English NLP tasks.

courses.title: Building Agentic AI Systems
courses.description: Design LLM agents, sub-agents, RAG, LangGraph workflows, memory, human-in-the-loop, reliability, and observability. Ends with a capstone project.

courses.title: Computer Vision
courses.description: Image classification, object detection, and segmentation using convolutional and transformer-based vision models.

courses.title: MLOps & Model Deployment
courses.description: Packaging, serving, monitoring, and CI/CD for machine learning models in production environments.
